title: Weekend and Friday Slot Weighting — Tailwise Grooming Salon Prepaid Pass Late Cancellations
content:
On a prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon pass (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom or Spa Groom pass), the pass late-cancellation fee carries a slot multiplier set by the weekday of the appointment that was cancelled.

**Rule.** The slot multiplier of the pass late-cancellation fee follows the weekday of the cancelled appointment date — the appointment date recorded on the most recently recorded cancellation on the pass with a fee remedy:

| Weekday of the cancelled appointment date | Slot multiplier |
|---|---|
| Saturday or Sunday | 1.25 |
| Friday | 1.1 |
| Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday | 1 |

The slot multiplier multiplies the pass late-cancellation fee as a whole.

**Weekday reckoning.** The weekday is that of the appointment date on the ordinary calendar, counted in unbroken seven-day weeks from Saturday 2024-01-06. The weekday of the day the cancellation was recorded plays no part.

**Illustrations (hypothetical pass with a late-cancellation fee figure of 15.00)**

| Cancelled appointment date | Weekday | Fee after the slot multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 2024-01-06 | Saturday | 15.00 multiplied by 1.25, that is 18.75 |
| 2024-01-07 | Sunday | 18.75 |
| 2024-01-05 | Friday | 15.00 multiplied by 1.1, that is 16.50 |
| 2024-01-04 | Thursday | 15.00 |

A Friday appointment cancelled late on the Thursday before takes the Friday multiplier: the appointment date decides.
